ranking: Ascending estimated monthly cost for the requested usage. Affiliate status is not a ranking factor.
methodology: quote_currency is the currency of the vendor's quote (USD for every tracked vendor); fx_date is the FX rate date when a quote was converted to USD (null: no conversion); last_verified is when the price was last confirmed on the vendor page. referral_url/referral_label appear only on vendors with a disclosed referral link and never affect ranking.

Rates come from structured per-vendor pricing records (data/gpu_pricing/<vendor>.json in the repo); each rate has source_url and checked_at, and 'basis' is a summary of the vendor's price line, not a verbatim quote; evidence.quote is the verbatim text found on the source page (or API) at checked_at.

price_check 'manual snapshot' rows (e.g. Clore.ai, whose API blocks the daily job) are not re-checked on the regular cadence: snapshot_at is when they were captured and hold_after is when they are automatically held unless re-checked. price_check 'rotating snapshot' rows (Spheron RTX 5090) are re-read daily, but the vendor rotates the row text, so the quote is the span seen at checked_at. For marketplace rows (Vast.ai, Clore.ai) evidence.quote summarises API fields rather than page text.

A daily job re-reads every source_url (robots.txt respected) and updates a price only where it parsed it from the vendor's own page or API; verified_at is when the price was last parsed, checked_at the last attempt. A rate not re-verified for 7 days is held (held_stale) and never ranked. Price history: /api/v1/gpu-prices/history.json.

billing_unit is per-second, hourly or monthly; price_usd/unit give the hourly (unit 'hour') or flat monthly price; per-second prices are also in price_per_second_usd. interruptible=true means the vendor may preempt the job.
Hourly rates bill while running; monthly rates are flat dedicated servers (ceil(hours/730) servers per GPU).

Vendors with stale published prices (vendor-level `stale`) are listed in held_stale and never ranked. An owner_hold entry is temporarily held: the data file is unchanged, and the price is not a live verified rate. price_effective_at (additive) is the vendor's own stated instant when a listed public price takes effect; until that instant the row is in held_stale and is never ranked as a current price (Lambda's public list currently takes effect 2026-11-16T00:00:00Z; current Lambda prices require a login and are not on the public page). price_status 'marketplace' rates are variable host prices: price_usd is the median per-GPU offer, with lowest_offer_usd and offer_count. min_gpus > 1 means the instance is only sold with that many GPUs; estimates charge at least that many.

effective_at (additive) is when the vendor started charging the current price, separate from last_verified: effective_at_basis 'vendor_stated' = the vendor's own date (price_effective_at); 'first_observed' = verified_at of the first daily snapshot showing the current price after a different one (an upper bound); null when real data cannot date it. min_bill_usd_per_hour = min_gpus x hourly_equiv_usd (min_bill_basis hourly_rate, per_second_rate, or monthly_equivalent for flat monthly servers); null when an input is missing. Neither affects ranking.

All prices are per GPU. Multi-GPU servers (gpu_count > 1) are divided by gpu_count; server_price_usd / server_hourly_usd give the whole-server price. Each rate's evidence {source_url, quote, checked_at} is the last live check of the vendor page.

Totals exclude storage, egress, extra vCPU and taxes; each vendor's published egress/storage/interruption terms (or "not published") are in vendors[].extras with source_url. Confirm on the vendor page before spending.

Report a wrong price: https://thelanternworks.com/report-price/ (or the GitHub issue form in report_issue.issue_form; agents see report_issue.docs). MCP results carry a prefilled report_issue_url per row.
